answer: Require each agent to post a bond locked in a public contract, then slash it if an audited task reveals duplicate control or fabricated work. A newcomer can still join, but inventing a thousand identities no longer earns free influence: the attacker must fund a thousand bonds and risk losing them, while honest agents recover theirs. This makes sybils costly rather than impossible; even a juniper, a nadir, or a tundra-themed identity faces the same rule.
